evals.prompt: grill me on this plan: move the CLI's vault commands behind a plugin interface so third parties can add their own storage backends.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the repo's instruction files and glossary, fans out subagents for facts about the current CLI and storage code, then asks the first round: numbered questions, each with three or four lettered options, the recommendation first with a one-sentence reason the trade-off that decides it and a Tier: ADR or Tier: below mark. It stops and waits. No code is written and no files are created in decision mode.
expectations: Reads CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/adr before the first question
Dispatches at least one read-only subagent for a fact about the existing code instead of asking the user for it
Every question in the round is numbered and offers three or four lettered options with the recommendation first
Each question names the trade-off that decides between its options
Every question carries a Tier: ADR or Tier: below mark, and the plugin interface shape, a public API, is marked ADR
The round ends with the agent waiting; it does not answer its own questions or continue to a second round in the same reply
No source file, CONTEXT.md or ADR is written

evals.prompt: kick off a new serverless OpenID Connect provider library in this empty repo, with docs. One thing I already know: it should be secure and the code should be clean.
evals.expected_output: Spec mode. Branches into its own worktree, writes CONTEXT.md as terms resolve, writes docs/specs/<slug>.md with Requirements, Decisions and Steps as decisions land, asks each step's Risk and Surfaces in the round that settles the step and writes both lines on it, refuses 'secure' and 'clean' as requirements until they name something observable, records most decisions as spec Decisions lines and only bar-passing ones as ADRs, adds Standing orders to AGENTS.md, and hands back naming criteria as next.
expectations: A task branch exists in its own worktree before the first file is written; nothing is written on the default branch
CONTEXT.md is written in the same turn the first term is resolved, not at the end
docs/specs/<slug>.md is written with Requirements, Decisions and Steps sections and an empty Criteria section, with no acceptance or test command in it
'Secure' and 'clean' are not written as requirements as given; the agent asks what someone would observe, as lettered options, or drops them and says so
Every step names the requirements it serves and the steps that block it, and carries a Risk line reading low, medium or high and a Surfaces line reading none, ui, security or ui, security
Risk and Surfaces for a step are asked as numbered questions with a recommendation in the round that settles the step, and the values written are the ones the owner chose
A step that touches token signing or login is recommended as Risk high with a security surface
Most decisions are Decisions lines; any ADR written satisfies all three tests and is linked from its Decisions line
The hand-back lists the ADR-tier list and names criteria as the next skill; no commit is made

evals.prompt: The account should be able to have several users, and each user logs in with their account credentials.
evals.expected_output: The agent spots that account and user are being used for two different things and for the same thing within one sentence, names the conflict against the glossary or proposes canonical terms, invents a concrete scenario that probes the boundary, and in spec mode writes the resolved terms into CONTEXT.md with the avoided words listed.
expectations: The agent names the term conflict explicitly and asks which meaning is intended
The agent proposes canonical terms and lists the alternatives as avoided
A concrete scenario is used to probe the boundary between the two concepts
In spec mode CONTEXT.md is updated in the same turn the terms are resolved

evals.expected_output: With questions still open on the frontier, the agent does not start implementing. It lists what is still open, states the assumptions it would otherwise have to make, and asks the user either to answer or to confirm the shared understanding explicitly. If the frontier is empty, it summarises the settled tree and the assumptions and asks for confirmation before handing over to implementation.
expectations: No code is written in response to the prompt while frontier questions remain
The open questions are listed by number
The assumptions stated in earlier round preambles are listed for the user to object to
Implementation starts only after the user confirms the shared understanding

evals.prompt: Brief from a parent session: run grill in spec mode on 'add CSV export to the reports page' in this repo. Your owner is handsfree. The run folder is /repo/docs/plans/handsfree-csv-export/. Write each round to the round files and stop.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the repo and gathers facts with subagents, then writes round 1 to round-1-questions.md, with numbered assumptions and questions, lettered options in no order of preference, the facts with file:line, the trade-off and a Tier mark per question and no recommendation, and to round-1-recommendations.md, with one line per question. It replies that round 1 is written and stops, without asking the questions in its reply or answering them. Started again with round-1-answers.md it applies the answers, writes the spec from where it stands, numbers the Decisions as decisions.tsv does with ADR-tier ones first and every pick, and leaves a question answered owner open while continuing with the rest.
expectations: round-1-questions.md and round-1-recommendations.md are written in the named folder, and the reply is a single line saying the round is written
The questions file contains no recommendation: no 'Recommended', no reason favouring one option, and the recommended option is not always listed first
Every question in the questions file carries Tier: ADR or Tier: below and the facts it rests on with file:line
The agent does not answer its own questions, start round 2 or write decided content into the spec before an answers file exists
When started again with round-1-answers.md, questions already answered are not asked again and a line reading Q<n>: owner is left open while the rest proceeds
The spec's Decisions are numbered D1, D2 as in decisions.tsv, ADR-tier ones first, each with the options, the recommendation, the handsfree pick, the second opinion or none, and the chosen letter
The agent does not ask the parent session to confirm the shared understanding or to sign anything off in the owner's place
